first_paragraph: GoGloby is an Applied AI Engineering partner. We turn engineering into AI-native production for established software companies: we find what’s slowing your engineering down, put the right people inside your team to fix it, and prove the result every month. We embed Forward-Deployed Engineers. Senior AI engineers inside your team in under 4 weeks, shipping at AI speed against your own baseline. We prove AI ROI.
